summary: Multiplies a 16-element 4x4 matrix a3 by a 4-component vector a2 and writes the four result components to the output vector a1, returning a1. Straight-line computation of four dot products (one per output component) with no branches or calls.

operations.description: v4 = a2[0]*a3[0] + a2[1]*a3[4] + a2[2]*a3[8] + a2[3]*a3[12] (dot product of vector a2 with matrix row 0)
v5 = a2[0]*a3[1] + a2[1]*a3[5] + a2[2]*a3[9] + a2[3]*a3[13] (dot product of vector a2 with matrix row 1)
v6 = a2[0]*a3[2] + a2[1]*a3[6] + a2[2]*a3[10] + a2[3]*a3[14] (dot product of vector a2 with matrix row 2)
v7 = a2[0]*a3[3] + a2[1]*a3[7] + a2[2]*a3[11] + a2[3]*a3[15] (dot product of vector a2 with matrix row 3)
a1[0] = v4; write result component 0 to output vector first element
a1[1] = v5; write result component 1 to output vector second element
a1[2] = v6; write result component 2 to output vector third element
a1[3] = v7; write result component 3 to output vector fourth element
return a1 (pointer to the output vector)
